response.original_title: Buck-Tick: One Life, One Death Cut Up
response.overview: This is a live concert DVD from the Japanese visual-kei/rock band Buck-Tick, released March 28, 2001 on BMG/Funhouse in Japan (catalog number BVBR-11004).  It captures the final date of the "TOUR ONE LIFE, ONE DEATH," filmed live at Nippon Budokan on December 29, 2000 — notably Buck-Tick's last live show of the 20th century. The DVD covers the show complete from the opening number through the encore, and includes some rare monologue clips from band members not found elsewhere, presented in a color-case edition. It was tied to the album One Life, One Death (their 11th studio album, released September 20, 2000 on BMG/Funhouse), and a companion CD album and VHS version were released simultaneously, each containing slightly different material from the DVD.
response.title: Buck-Tick: One Life, One Death Cut Up
